incidents.body:
We’ve completed recovery efforts related to the earlier AWS outage, and the Highspot platform is now fully operational.  End users can access Highspot without issue, and all services are performing as expected.

Our team will continue to monitor system stability closely, but no further impact is anticipated.

Thank you for your patience while we worked through this incident.
